item.title: RNAkinet Published in NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics
item.description: Our deep learning tool for direct sequencing of labeled RNA, RNAkinet, is published in NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics.

item.title: Gene Body Hydroxymethylation Paper Published in Nature Communications
item.description: Our study on how DNA hydroxymethylation restricts transcriptional changes during aging is published in Nature Communications.

item.title: Maragkakis Lab Joins NIA
item.description: The Maragkakis Lab, led by Dr. Emmanouil Maragkakis, officially joins the Laboratory of Genetics and Genomics at the National Institute on Aging.
